technique_name: Write a short essay about the impact of social media in our lives.
description: In recent years, the prevalence of social media has revolutionized the way people communicate, interact, and connect with one another. It has allowed people to build networks throughout the world, share their ideas and opinions, and access information in ways that would have been impossible before its advent.
